results.title: Arriba Tutto
results.overview: A seven-year-old boy's magical childhood with his street performer father ends tragically. Years later, he struggles with anger and bitterness, having lost the joy and wonder he once knew.

results.title: Split Rock
results.overview: A team of geologists uncover a strange anomaly buried deep in the remote badlands and fall prey to a sinister force of destruction.

results.title: Strangers and Their Babies
results.overview: Four people of Vietnamese descent retrace their families' flight across open water to Taiwan, uncovering two Penghu Island refugee camps left out of UN records — where 106 babies were born, many without papers.

results.title: Apocalypse Z: New World
results.overview: The Canary Islands have become Europe’s last refuge following the outbreak of the TSJ virus. When a special mission sets out for the mainland in search of vital supplies, Roberto joins the team with questionable intentions. The dangerous operation turns into a desperate race for survival, and Roberto and his companions find themselves caught between hordes of infected and divided loyalties.

results.title: Chasing Millions
results.overview: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.

results.title: The Trumpeter and the Ghost
results.overview: A frustrated jazz trumpeter rehearsing for an audition accidentally awakens an invisible ghost with the power to manipulate sound. The ghost promises to turn him into a virtuoso in exchange for his help unearthing an ancient treasure buried deep in the mountains. But what begins as a great deal soon becomes a dangerous adventure leading toward a dark secret.

results.title: My Sister's Everlasting Garden
results.original_title: Ao Sâu Nước Chiếu Bóng Hoa Cúc Vàng
results.overview: On a damped winter morning, Chi and her family gather to mourn the loss of her beloved elder sister, who valiantly battled breast cancer for nearly 15 years. The somber funeral becomes a poignant journey for Chi as she is transported back in time through the power of little objects and familiar places, each triggering a cascade of memories tied to her sister. As Chi revisits their past conversations, a profound shift occurs within her. The questions surrounding the purpose of life, which she had always held onto with unwavering certainty, begin to unravel. In this bittersweet exploration, the bond between the two sisters deepens beyond the constraints of mortality. As Chi delves into the depths of their shared experiences, she begins to embrace a new understanding of existence, one that defies conventional boundaries and provides a sense of solace in the face of loss.

results.title: Adult Supervision
results.overview: Three fathers accompany their teenage daughters on a school trip to a remote island. What begins as a peaceful getaway soon turns into a series of unexpected problems. Each father has a different approach to parenting, influenced by his own past experiences, and their conflicting views create tension among them. As the situation becomes increasingly difficult to control, memories of their past return and force them to confront their mistakes and shortcomings. The trip ultimately leaves them questioning who is really in control.

results.title: Blind Ants
results.overview: In 1935, a storm caused an English ship carrying coal to run aground in Bizkaia. Residents of Algorta gathered to rescue the coal, but Sabas Jauregui ignored their pleas and dragged his children into the storm.

results.title: Double Trouble
results.overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

results.title: Comrade Kalyan
results.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

results.title: Devour
results.overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

results.title: How Hard Can It Be?
results.overview: Mallory, an ambitious New York reporter, is assigned to a story on the Best Small Town in America, sending her to Alabama. Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.

results.title: Reporting Live
results.overview: A young reporter and her reluctant cameraman chase a story, only to get entangled in an illegal sand-mining racket run by a ruthless syndicate.

results.title: Misty Green
results.overview: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.

results.title: A Breed Apart
results.overview: An English cattle breeder and his 9-year-old son struggle to connect while settling in 1850s Canada.

results.title: Learners
results.overview: When a cantankerous widower reluctantly agrees to teach his son's unemployed girlfriend to drive, an unlikely friendship is sparked.

results.title: Falling
results.overview: Jack, while quick-witted, charming, and avoidant, finally risks opening his heart when he starts dating Jillian. He never expected, though, that his best friend Johnny would fall for her, too.

results.title: Tenzing
results.overview: A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

results.title: A Prayer for the Dying
results.overview: In 1870 Friendship, Wisconsin, a small town of Scandinavian settlers still suffering the repercussions of the recent Civil War. When faced with a new and even deadlier threat, one man is forced to make a harrowing choice: save his young family or defend the community that gave him a second chance at life and meaning.
